scope: Elastic-lattice consistency, independent dispersion and planar reflection references; not physical wood/UB1000 validation

checks.name: Compression mode matches independent lattice dispersion
Compression long-wave speed agrees with continuum
Shear mode matches independent lattice dispersion
Shear long-wave speed agrees with continuum
Rigid translation generates no elastic strain
Internal elastic forces conserve linear momentum
Undamped integration stays bounded
Viscous absorption matches exponential rigid-velocity decay
Interface reflection agrees with impedance coefficient
Interface transmission agrees with impedance coefficient
Sound specimen and independent sound run have identical receiver trace
Wave sequence evolves from rest
Recorded times and samples are finite
Chosen pulse has at least sixteen cells per sound wavelength
Cavity has no mass or stiffness-bearing nodes
Cavity has zero wave displacement in every frame
Cavity changes received waveform
Decay reduces speed and increases absorption independently of structural E
Decay produces a distinct finite response
Under-resolved drilling is explicitly identified
First-arrival estimate stable within 10 microseconds under refinement
